_instructions: Convert the article below into this JSON. REQUIRED: title, summary, description, author, blocks (at least 3 blocks), keyTakeaways (exactly 3 strings — never empty), includeQuiz true with 3–4 questions. Each quiz question: exactly 4 options, one correct, three plausible wrong answers from the sermon (not silly). Set correctIndex to the 0-based index of the correct option. Use placeholder text like [Review: add scripture] only if truly missing — never leave strings empty. Omit image, video, and FAQ blocks unless the article includes them. REQUIRED: fill the tags array with 1–2 tags from _allowedTags based on content relevance (see _tagInstructions). Do not include date, hero image, featured, or published.
title: Your article title
summary: 2–3 sentences shown at the top of the article page. Warm, clear, visitor-friendly.
description: One or two sentences for Google and social link previews.
author: ROLCC Pastoral Team

blocks.text: Opening paragraph. Keep it short and welcoming for first-time readers.
Quoted verse or line of teaching.

keyTakeaways: First short takeaway — one complete sentence.
Second short takeaway — one complete sentence.
Third short takeaway — one complete sentence.

quiz.question: What does Jesus call Himself in John 8:12?
quiz.explanation: John 8:12 — Jesus says, 'I am the light of the world.'

quiz.question: Second question based on the article?
Third question based on the article?

_tagInstructions: Read the full sermon article (title, summary, description, blocks, and takeaways). From _allowedTags only, pick the 1–2 tags that best match the content's main themes, emotional tone, and practical application. Use exact spelling. Prefer 2 tags when the sermon clearly spans two topics (e.g. anxiety at work → Anxiety & Stress and Work & Calling). Never invent tags outside _allowedTags.
